description: An addon with bug-patches for the popular 1.7.10 mod Thaumcraft NEI Plugin, made by Jan2048.

releases.notes:
- Added two new config entries, for debugging specifically Infusion and ArcaneShapeless recipes.
- Added a new "crash-avoiding" handler for Arcane Shapeless recipes, automaticly loading when debug is turned off.
  - This is and will be the same for each handler which got its own debug config entry

- Added a config file related to the mod - can be found in its appropriate folder
  - Added one config entry for debug mode. You should keep that one off as it will avoid any bugged recipe while it's off.
- Deleted dependency/integration with Thaumic Exploration and Thaumcraft 4 : Patched

## Patched bugs :
- **Infusion**, **Crucible** and both **Shaped** & **Shapeless Arcane** used to have issues not showing all recipes in the original mod. This was caused by the mod comparing the stackSize from the item clicked and all recipes.
  - For exemple, Crucible recipe for Thauminite [Thaumic Bases] yields 8 nuggets. If you clicked the Thauminite nugget in NotEnoughItems menu, it would show you no recipe, as the item you click in NEI only got a stackSize of 1, and the output of that recipe got a stackSize of 8.

## New features :
- Infusion is now compatible with checking ItemStack with infamous metadata **32767**
- Refactored part of the code with modern syntax
